apple.questionnaire: Updated age rating questionnaire required since 2026-01-31

answers.question: Parental Controls
answers.rationale: Zenguy has no child-oriented content filters, usage limits or parental restriction tools.

answers.question: Age Assurance
answers.rationale: Zenguy does not estimate or verify age and does not use the Declared Age Range API.

answers.question: Unrestricted Web Access
answers.rationale: The app has no address bar or general-purpose embedded browser; it displays stored evidence from authorized remote tests and opens only fixed product or legal links externally.

answers.question: User-Generated Content
answers.rationale: Customer-authored configuration and evidence remain inside a private access-controlled workspace and are not broadly distributed as part of the intended experience.

answers.question: Social Media
answers.rationale: The app has no social feed, discovery, likes, comments, shares or content amplification.

answers.question: Social Media Disabled for Users Under 13
answers.rationale: The app has no social-media capability for any user and does not use the Declared Age Range API.

answers.question: Messaging and Chat
answers.rationale: The app has no direct messaging, group chat or public posting feature.

answers.question: Advertising
answers.rationale: The app contains no paid advertising formats.

answers.question: Profanity or Crude Humor
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no profanity or crude humor.

answers.question: Horror/Fear Themes
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no horror or fear themes.

answers.question: Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no alcohol, tobacco or drug depictions or references.

answers.question: Medical or Treatment Information
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no diagnosis, treatment or medical-management guidance.

answers.question: Health or Wellness Topics
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no self-care, diet, exercise or lifestyle recommendations.

answers.question: Mature or Suggestive Themes
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no mature or suggestive themes.

answers.question: Sexual Content or Nudity
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no sexual content or nudity.

answers.question: Graphic Sexual Content and Nudity
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no graphic sexual content or nudity.

answers.question: Cartoon or Fantasy Violence
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no cartoon or fantasy violence.

answers.question: Realistic Violence
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no realistic violence.

answers.question: Prolonged Graphic or Sadistic Realistic Violence
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no prolonged graphic or sadistic realistic violence.

answers.question: Guns or Other Weapons
answers.rationale: Zenguy supplies no depictions of guns or other weapons.

answers.question: Gambling
answers.rationale: The app has no real-money or exchangeable-currency wagering.

answers.question: Simulated Gambling
answers.rationale: The app has no simulated wagering.

answers.question: Contests
answers.rationale: The app has no competitions, rankings or rewards.

answers.question: Loot Boxes
answers.rationale: The app has no randomized virtual items for purchase.
